profile.headline: Senior Software Developer @ Peraton | Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals / Azure AI Fundamentals
profile.summary:
At DigitalOnUs by Tech Mahindra, collaboration and innovation are the keystones of my role as Senior Software Developer. With expertise in Azure cloud solutions, including Azure Functions and Service Bus, my contributions have been pivotal in creating scalable and robust systems. My tenure at DXC Technology fortified my skills, where I developed critical applications with a focus on Angular, enhancing user experiences and system performance.

  

Our team's success in delivering complex software solutions is a testament to our collective capability to navigate and integrate intricate business processes. My certification in Azure Fundamentals underscores a commitment to leveraging cutting-edge technologies to achieve operational excellence. Bridging the gap between technical solutions and business needs, I am dedicated to advancing our company's mission through strategic innovation and technical leadership.
